title: UI Half Marathon 2026 Review: Universitas Indonesia's Campus 21K
seo_title: UI Half Marathon 2026 Review | Universitas Indonesia Depok Race
meta_description: The UI Half Marathon 2026: October 11 at Universitas Indonesia campus, Depok. 21K, 10K, 5K from ILUNI UI — one of Indonesia's most iconic campus races reviewed.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 on the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok, this ILUNI UI-organised half marathon is one of Indonesia's most iconic campus road races. Three distances. A leafy, car-free university-grounds 21K.
verdict: The UI Half Marathon is one of Indonesia's most distinctive road races by venue alone: the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok — a sprawling, forested university grounds with wide roads, dedicated jogging paths, and the iconic UI library as backdrop. Organised by ILUNI UI (the university's alumni association), it carries genuine institutional roots. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). October in Depok is the transition from dry to wet season — expect warm, humid conditions. For runners wanting a campus-based Indonesian half marathon with a uniquely leafy, car-free environment, this is a standout.
